links.outcome: Clinician FH knowledge following bundled education and clinical decision-support implementation
links.effect: Following the bundled intervention, respondents correctly answering at least 2/3rds of FH knowledge questions increased from 40 to 65 %. Surveys included n = 55 at baseline and n = 23 at follow-up; comparisons were unpaired.
links.quote: Objective PCC knowledge scores improved from 40 to 65 % of responders correctly responding to at least 2/3rds of survey questions.

links.outcome: Clinician response and management choice after algorithm-triggered outreach with defined follow-up options
links.effect: Among 25 PCCs contacted through EMR in-basket outreach offering primary-care workup or specialist referral, the cumulative response rate was 56 %; 100 % of respondents chose specialist referral.
links.quote: 25 PCCs whose patients had been flagged by the FIND FH® MLA were contacted iteratively through an EMR in-basket message with a 56 % cumulative response rate.
